verdict.line: You're behind if Sion free-farms Enrage health stacks and threatens Cryptic Gaze from brush; you're ahead once his Q is down and you force the all-in.

brief.thesis: Sion's E (Enrage) has no cooldown and lets him trade health for Attack Damage while permanently banking max Health on every kill, including minions, so he snowballs a raw stat lead through the laning phase even though his own numbers (46.8% Malphite win rate over 235 games) sit below Malphite's overall top-lane rate of 51.9%. Malphite's answer is patience: Granite Shield and an Armor-scaling Ground Slam (E) only pay off once he stops eating free poke, which means timing fights around Sion's Q (Cryptic Gaze) cooldown rather than contesting every wave.

theirWindow.when: Sion's Q is fully charged near brush
theirWindow.what: He's set up the stun OP.GG warns about. Don't stand still in his charge range; if he tags you, land Seismic Shard (Q) on him immediately to steal his Movement Speed and walk out instead of trading into a stunned burst.

yourWindow.when: Sion just used or dropped his Q charge
yourWindow.what: Cryptic Gaze is on a 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown with no stun backup, so step in with Brutal Strikes (W) for the Armor/AD buff and auto-trade, or at level 6+ threaten Unstoppable Force (R) since Malphite holds the solo-kill advantage in this matchup.

powerCurve.note: Early Cryptic Gaze stun punishes any extended trade

start.why: 53.2% win rate over 47 games — the sustain and early trade damage reduction directly counters Sion's auto-attack-reliant Enrage pokes better than the higher-pick-rate Doran's Ring line.

boots.why: 52% win rate over 171 games; Sion's entire kit (autos, Enrage, Cannibalism leech) is physical and auto-based, so flat reduction on every hit matters more than magic resist.

core.why: Part of the 66.7% win rate path over 21 games; the burn punishes Sion for sticking around while his Enrage is active.
Reflects damage straight back into an attack-speed/AD-stacked Sion, turning his own Enrage trades against him.
Closes out the highest-win-rate core path and adds Armor that directly scales Ground Slam's (E) damage.

situational.when: if the enemy team stacks magic damage alongside Sion
if you need a flexible mixed-damage tank item for a split physical/magic team
if you need your Unstoppable Force to secure kills rather than just peel

runes.keystoneWhy: 50% win rate at 40.8% pick; the heal-on-proc and bonus max Health directly offset Sion's HP-stacking Enrage trades, letting you win sustained lane exchanges instead of racing his burst. Master-tier Malphites instead run Arcane Comet (41.2% win rate, 3,134 games) — that fits a more aggressive player who wants to poke Sion's slow approach rather than out-sustain him.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite posts the higher win rate (52.4% over a 14.3% pick share) and converts Malphite's solo-kill advantage into actual kills during his all-in windows; Flash + Teleport is the standard pick (84.3%) if you'd rather prioritize scaling and side-lane flexibility over early kill pressure.

playing.title: Trade only after Q whiffs or lands
playing.detail: Cryptic Gaze needs to charge before it stuns, so once Sion fires it (hit or miss) his stun is gone for 12 to 8 seconds depending on rank. That's your window to step in with Brutal Strikes (W) or autos.

playing.title: Respect brush-charged Q
playing.detail: OP.GG flags this directly: don't idle in his charge range near brush. If tagged, immediately cast Seismic Shard (Q) on him to steal his Movement Speed and disengage rather than fighting into the stun.

playing.title: Let Enrage burn him down
playing.detail: Enrage has zero cooldown but costs Sion Health per attack while toggled on. If he commits to it, hold through Granite Shield's recharge and land Ground Slam (E) once he's already spent HP.

playing.title: Avoid extended 1v1s after level 6
playing.detail: Cannibalism (R, 90s cooldown) leeches Health back to Sion on every hit once active. Long drawn-out trades favor him post-6; short, decisive ones favor you.

playing.title: Scale Armor before forcing E trades
playing.detail: Ground Slam's damage is based on Malphite's Armor stat, so it hits far harder once Plated Steelcaps and Sunfire Aegis are online than it does at level 3-4.

playing.title: All-in on cooldown, not on cooldown reset
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force (R) is 130/115/100/80/80s depending on rank — track his death timer or last ult usage so you're not initiating into a free Cannibalism heal.

playing.title: Swap to Comet if you're ahead
playing.detail: If you're winning trades and holding wave fine, master-tier Malphites drop Grasp for Arcane Comet to add poke damage and push the skill matchup further in your favor.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune win rates, and the 46.8% head-to-head figure are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the trade-timing and cooldown-window analysis is my own reading of the kit, not a measured stat.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Sion’s fully charged (Q) used from inside a brush! Use the bonus movement speed on [Q] to simply step away temporarily.
